explanation: The islands lie closer to Myanmar and Indonesia than to the Indian mainland. Their main town is more than 1,300 km from Chennai.

claims.text: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands belong to India.
The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are not part of Myanmar, Thailand or Indonesia.
The Andaman and Nicobar Islands lie closer to Myanmar and Indonesia than to mainland India.
Port Blair is more than 1,300 km from Chennai.
Port Blair is the main town of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
